policy: No shared helper. Each direct Awaitility chain has same-thread/dontCatchUncaughtExceptions/ignoreNoExceptions and explicit old sleep-boundary interrupt checks. CheckedExceptionRethrower.safeRethrow0 preserves the original callback throwable type.
remainingLimits: Exact instruction-level arrival timing is not claimed; scheduler/condition overhead up to one old polling turn still requires review/runtime disposition.
A VM-specific raw Thread.sleep interruption message/stack cannot be recreated; the preserved contract is checked InterruptedException with cleared status and original caller catch/flag behavior.
Do not keep any batch whose interruption/timeout paths are unproved within the source-order/timebox gate.
